description: This file defines React components and hooks related to data table UI, including pagination, server data fetching, fallback to demo data, sorting, and table rendering.

methods.name: Pagination({ page, pageSize, total, onPageChange })
methods.description: A React component for paginating data, providing previous/next buttons and page indicator.

methods.name: isNetworkError(e)
methods.description: Detects if an error is a network error based on response or error code.

methods.name: isNotFound(e)
methods.description: Detects if an error indicates a 404 Not Found response.

methods.name: buildFallbackRows(fallbackKey, { page, pageSize, sort, filter })
methods.description: Builds fallback dataset for a specific resource key, applying filters and sorting, using demo data.

methods.name: useServerTable({ path, page, pageSize, sort, filter, fallbackKey = null })
methods.description: Custom hook to fetch table data from API with server-side pagination, sorting, and filtering. Falls back to demo data on certain errors.

methods.name: DataTable({ columns, rows, sort, onSortChange, loading, emptyText = "No data", onRowClick })
methods.description: React component rendering a sortable table, with support for loading state, empty data, and row click handling.
